quote: Better than the original, with a better sense of immersion, and the animation guides the plot more clearly. It truly deserves to be called the number one masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: soniction0128
quote: It has absolutely no GTA feel to it; it's practically a rip-off of RDR2. What a waste of 13 years of waiting.

author: soniction0128
quote: I experienced a 4K 60FPS shooter on the Nintendo Switch 2. Compared to the MP1 remake, the MP4 is a huge improvement. There are also NPCs to talk to during the game, which reduces the feeling of loneliness. A great game to release at the end of the year.

author: soniction0128
quote: The game runs at 60 frames per second in 4K throughout, providing a smooth and fluid experience. It also completes the story of Kingdom Tears: The Lost. A great game not to be missed.

author: soniction0128
quote: The brand new action-based gameplay makes you immersed in the game and want to keep playing!

author: soniction0128
quote: Finally, it returns to the Japanese turn-based RPG gameplay. The characters are also newly created, plus there is a brand new story. I highly recommend buying and playing it!

author: soniction0128
quote: Although it has been a while since the previous game, this new racing game has added a lot of new elements. Unfortunately, the sense of speed when cornering is still very bad. When playing with multiple people online, the picture is really too chaotic!

author: soniction0128
quote: Although it is an old game HD, it has improved the picture quality and control feel, and the JOY-CON has also optimized the physical feel. If you want to recall Mario Galaxy, you can try it.
game_title: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2

author: soniction0128
quote: The gameplay is similar to the previous game in terms of control. I feel that the whole map has been changed and the rest is copied and pasted. There is no breakthrough.

author: soniction0128
quote: 120fps is awesome,Just as fun as the previous generation, but with a lot more added.
